scope: Existing nine e2e files; new audio-integration.e2e.mjs runs separately

resolvedFailures.test: G3: pause remains usable during the first stationary guide
resolvedFailures.initialCause: Opening ended naturally while Playwright waited for a pointer click on its skip button; setup-only button detached.
resolvedFailures.fix: Dispatch opening skip in setup; retain actual pause click and all pause assertions.

resolvedFailures.initialCause: Initial whole-suite process omitted local PostgreSQL admin URL and initdb was not installed.
resolvedFailures.fix: Rerun with disposable postgres:16 at loopback, existing psql Docker wrapper and KAMEREORU_TEST_ADMIN_URL.
resolvedFailures.additionalSetupIssue: NET-TEST-06 helper unconditionally clicked the game Pause button behind an already displayed normal pause overlay. Helper now uses visible pause Home directly and asserts running=false. Networking assertions remain unchanged.

resolvedFailures.initialCause: Public v5 guide framing uses sceneT=2000+gameT*0.6 in first building. Old test incorrectly compared scene time directly against game time.
resolvedFailures.fix: Compare scene and game clocks against their own paused baselines; add exact fixed-scene checks while paused/hidden and preserve presentation/game elapsed limits.

conclusion: All 146 distinct existing tests have passing evidence across the initial and focused reruns; this is not a claim of a single clean full-suite run. No skips or production-code changes were used to resolve these failures. Final CI run must verify committed test fixes.
